messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool 'enterprise-gamma' GPU free < 8% · queue length 320 · avg util 95% across 16 GPUs. Paging oncall.

lina (oncall): ack. I'm on it. what's the customer impact right now?

miguel (sre): seeing sustained 95% util for ~6m, queueing on router + worker pods. p50 latency creeping to 800ms, p95 ~5.2s. errors low but timeouts increasing. spike aligns with gamma-prod/embeddings batch jobs.

zoe (eng-runtime): possible KV cache miss storm from long context windows + cold starts. options: 1) emergency burst from shared-burst pool, 2) manual scale-up of dedicated pool via infra, 3) quick autoscale policy relax (dangerous). Need acct/customer approval for burst due to cost.

erin (acct): pinged gamma primary (contacted via phone). They're on a data-sync; told us they can approve a short burst if it stabilizes prod. ETA response: 2m.

lina (oncall): miguel, run perf calc — how many GPUs to add to get queue < 30? zoe prepare rollback + flag to revert autoscale.

miguel (sre): quick sim from recent traces: +4 A100-equiv reduces queue ~40%, still ~180 reqs. +8 reduces to ~22 reqs and p95 down to ~1.1s. recommending +8 for 30-45m window.

erin (acct): customer confirmed — they approve a temporary capacity add for up to 45 minutes. they want cost estimate before we proceed.

lina (oncall): estimate?

miguel (sre): rough cost delta ~ $120/hr for 8 A100 equiv (includes infra + licensing). 45m ~= $90.

lina (oncall): approved by oncall. customer approved. proceed with emergency burst. @ops-bot, run: `adminctl burst --tenant enterprise-gamma --add 8gpus --duration 00:45 --reason "prod spike - approved by customer"`

ops-bot: Received. Allocating 8 GPUs from shared-burst-pool to enterprise-gamma. Expected readiness ~90s. Logging as incident 2026-03-15-INC-4721.

miguel (sre): new capacity active. pool size now 24 GPUs. queue dropping rapidly. p50 ~0.6s, p95 ~1.1s. no new errors. monitoring 0/.

raj (support): notifying customer: "We added temporary capacity to stabilize throughput; monitoring in progress. We'll update when normal." Will post a brief status msg in 5m.

zoe (eng-runtime): setting temporary autoscale-override flag to allow graceful additional headroom during the burst window; will auto-clear after window. Also enabling extra KV cache warming for hot prefixes.

lina (oncall): good. follow-ups: 1) create RCA ticket for cache misses, 2) evaluate pre-approved emergency burst for enterprise-gamma in contract, 3) cost addendum. tagging eng-runtime + acct.

ops-bot: Burst scheduled to auto-deallocate at 8776544299 unless extended. Allocation ID: brst-5592. Audit log saved.

miguel (sre): queue stable now, p95 down. keeping monitors at 1m cadence for 1h then scaling back. no negative side-effects observed.

erin (acct): customer confirmed improvement & thanked team. marked as mitigated on their side :white_check_mark:

lina (oncall): closing thread here. will file postmortem + cost breakdown. great coordination everyone.
